Portrait of Wong Ka Kui

Wong Ka Kui, the influential frontman of the Hong Kong rock band Beyond, is captured in a studio portrait wearing a vibrant red shirt against a smooth purple backdrop. His arms are crossed, and his serene expression reflects the introspective nature that characterized much of his songwriting.

This image accompanies a Bilibili video entry titled “黄家驹创作的经典歌曲！-TIME音乐,” part of a curated playlist showcasing classic compositions by various artists. The page lists view counts for each featured musician, with Wong Ka Kui’s segment noted for its popularity among fans of Cantonese rock music.

source.description:
Wong Ka Kui: Hong Kong Rock Pioneer

Wong Ka Kui, the charismatic leader of the band Beyond, challenged Hong Kong’s cover-driven music industry by writing and performing original rock songs. His breakthrough came with the award-winning track "Earth," followed by the anthem "Broad Sea and Sky," which cemented Beyond’s status in the late 1980s. 

In 1993, a tragic accident during a Japanese variety show recording resulted in severe head trauma that claimed his life at age 31. Backstage Peace Sign

A young man poses in what appears to be a dressing room, offering a friendly peace sign to the camera. He wears a denim jacket layered over a dark shirt and accessorizes with a thin chain necklace and small hoop earring. Behind him, a mirror reflects part of the room, and a colorful Donald Duck bag adds a playful touch to the scene.

The warm, even lighting highlights his relaxed expression and casual attire. This candid snapshot captures a moment of ease and approachability, suggesting a behind-the-scenes glimpse of a performer or entertainer preparing for an event.
